_note: Red laser diode module (650 nm), 2-terminal: anode, cathode. Engine (bw-board laser_diode): solved as an LED junction (2.2 V); its light is a threshold law, slopeWPerA x (I - thresholdA) above about 20 mA, falling with temperature, in a narrow Gaussian beam (divergenceMrad). Its light reaches a receiver through a light_path part. Leads one column apart.
